settings.hero_desc: A glossy balloon-style sculpture in vivid red on a branded base. A playful, premium art piece and corporate gift that brings colour and personality to a desk, reception or retail space.
settings.s1_body: Inspired by the joy of balloon art, this glossy sculpture brings colour and fun to any space. Finished in vivid red with a flawless sheen and mounted on a branded base, it makes a playful collectible, a premium corporate gift or a retail accent. We build it in any shape, colour and branding you like.
settings.case_body: Produced as a branded gift, these glossy balloon sculptures brought colour and personality to the recipients' desks - a playful, premium piece that stood out from the usual corporate gift.
settings.case_quote: So fun and beautifully made. It's the most cheerful thing on my desk.
settings.prov_p: Not every piece needs to be serious. A glossy, colourful sculpture brings personality and warmth to a space - and a smile to whoever receives it.
